content:
toni_rev: FYI we received an ACH return for invoice INV-2026-412 (Asterion Labs) for $8,760. Return code R01 (insufficient funds). Deposit batch ach_44221 failed.
maria_billing: thanks. do we have a saved card on file? any prior payment issues?
sam_ops: looking up account, system shows card on file but expired 2025-11. no prior returns in last 12 months. webhook payload: {return_code: R01, amount: 8760, tx: ach_44221, ts: 2026-03-03T10:12:08Z} (copied from logs)
toni_rev: customer emailed offering alternate proposal: pay 30% now, remainder in two equal installments over 60 days. wants to avoid collections. attached signed email thread.
ava_support: I replied asking for ACH re-init or new card details. asked them to confirm bank balance for retry and to upload authorization. no response yet. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria_billing: our standard is 1 manual ACH retry within 7 days. for partial payments we need approvals from finance+legal for exceptions to dunning cadence. pinging @lena_legal for signoff on installment plan.
lena_legal: legal is OK to accept a 3-installment split if a) signed installment agreement is received, b) late fee waiver is approved by finance, c) we log a note and set up automated reminders. will provide agreement template.
toni_rev: can finance approve late fee waiver? this customer is strategic and on a renewable committed contract.
maria_billing: propose waiving late fee if they enroll in autopay and we get the first installment within 5 business days. we should require saved card for remainder.
collections_bot: Action: placed invoice INV-2026-412 into "hold_for_negotiation" status. Next escalation paused until 2026-03-10.
sam_ops: reconciliation export queued: CSV snapshot:
account,invoice,amount,status
Asterion Labs,INV-2026-412,8760,return_R01

toni_rev: I'll draft the installment agreement and request card info. planning to call the CFO today 2026-03-03 16:00 PT. will post updates here. :phone:
maria_billing: thanks. also create an AR ticket for monitoring and set reminder 3/10 to check payment status.
collections_bot: Reminder set: check_INV-2026-412 on 2026-03-10.
ava_support: customer responded: "we can do first payment via ACH on 3/05 for $2,628, then 3/25 and 4/25 remaining". they asked for invoice to not be sent to collections.
lena_legal: uploaded installment agreement template link: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/installment-agreement. Toni, please attach signed copy.
toni_rev: got verbal commit, will attach signed PDF after CFO signs and will update here.
maria_billing: action items: 1) create installment schedule in billing portal; 2) set autopay requirement for subsequent charges; 3) waive late fee pending enrollment. assigning to maria_billing.
toni_rev: acknowledged. closing thread here but will re-open if ACH retry fails or if signed docs not received by 2026-03-06. closing ts 1967891567
